name: libaio
packaged_as: Static server link input, and the shared libaio.so.1 bundled in the Linux portable archive and the libs component; RPM and DEB packages use the distribution's libaio instead
redistribution: Retain the LGPL-2.1 text. The corresponding source ships with the compliance bundle under libaio/source/; keep it next to any copy of libaio.so.1 and keep the library replaceable so a user can relink against a modified libaio.
evidence: el8 manifest; package/package.py; bazel/third_party/targets.bzl; upstream 0.3.112 src/libaio.h and COPYING; development-kit devdeps-libaio-0.3.112-12022092915 ships an identical libaio.h; libaio-0.3.112.tar.xz sha256 f69e5800425f4ea957426693ac09f9896bb993db5490fa021644454adcc72a32 (matches libaio_0.3.112-9.dsc)
source_offer: libaio 0.3.112: the complete upstream source release is included with this bundle at libaio/source/libaio-0.3.112.tar.xz (sha256 f69e5800425f4ea957426693ac09f9896bb993db5490fa021644454adcc72a32; https://pagure.io/libaio). The bundled libaio.so.1.0.1 is built by the development kit from this release and no patches are published for it. Keep this archive together with the library in every distribution.
